_comment: Hand-verified offers, used only where the scraper cannot reach a rate.
A scraped offer with the same id always wins, so an entry here is a fallback,
not an override. Set observedAt to the date you actually opened the page:
the dashboard greys an entry out once it passes STALE_AFTER_DAYS.
Mortgages are empty on purpose. Austrian banks publish housing-loan pricing
through credit-scored calculators rather than rate cards, so there is no
honest figure to scrape. Add an entry here only from a bank's own published
representative example under HIKrG, with the URL it came from.
